narrative.value: Kawah Ijen is an active volcano at 2,386 m with the world's highest-volume acidic crater lake. Famous for the pre-dawn blue fire sulfuric-gas phenomenon — visible only in suitable weather and gas conditions. Access from Paltuding trailhead via a steep ~3 km night hike. BBKSDA East Java is the regulatory authority.

value.best_time_to_visit: May–October (dry season). Begin trek at 01:00–02:00 AM for blue fire and sunrise.
value.required_gear: Thermal layers, waterproof jacket, sturdy trekking boots, gas mask (for sulfur fumes), headlamp, warm hat.

narrative.value: Madakaripura is Java's tallest waterfall in Probolinggo, East Java. A narrow canyon gorge leads to a horseshoe curtain waterfall fed from multiple directions. Historical context: said to be the final meditation site of Gajah Mada, Majapahit prime minister. Easy ~20 min trek from roadside parking.

type.value: Horseshoe curtain waterfall in narrow canyon

value.best_time_to_visit: May–October. Morning or early afternoon for best light.
value.required_gear: Quick-dry clothing, waterproof bag, water shoes/sandals, poncho (expect to get fully wet), snacks.

value.best_time_to_visit: Year-round; cooler and more pleasant April–October.

narrative.value: Mount Bromo is an active volcano in the Tengger caldera, East Java. Best known for the Penanjakan sunrise viewpoint over the sea-of-sand caldera floor and the active smoking crater. Accessed by 4WD jeep from Cemoro Lawang in the pre-dawn window (03:00–05:00).

value.best_time_to_visit: May–October (dry season). Arrive at viewpoint by 04:30 AM for sunrise.
value.required_gear: Thermal jacket, sturdy trekking boots, flashlight/headlamp, sunscreen, dust/surgical mask.

narrative.value: Papuma Beach in Jember offers white sand and dramatic coastal rock formations. JVTO includes it as a coastal contrast stop on Papuma-family packages (4D+). Best for guests who want a beach break on an otherwise volcano-focused East Java itinerary.

type.value: White-sand beach with rocky cape (Tanjung Papuma)

value.best_time_to_visit: May–October. Late afternoon for sunset views.
value.required_gear: Light clothing, sandals, sunscreen, hat, water, camera.

value.best_time_to_visit: May–October. Open at 08:30 AM. Animals most active morning and late afternoon.
value.required_gear: Comfortable clothing, walking shoes, sunscreen, hat, camera.

narrative.value: Tumpak Sewu is a multi-tiered canyon waterfall (~120 m) in Lumajang, East Java. Nicknamed 'Java's Niagara' for its curtain of streams cascading over a curved cliff face into a canyon. Accessed via rim viewpoint or steep canyon descent (~300 steps).

name.value: Tumpak Sewu Waterfall (Air Terjun Tumpak Sewu)

value.best_time_to_visit: May–October (dry season). Morning for best light and fewer crowds.
value.required_gear: Quick-dry clothing, non-slip shoes/sandals, poncho, waterproof bag for valuables, trekking poles optional.

value.body:
A health certificate is mandatory for every guest before Kawah Ijen crater entry, per BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024. JVTO coordinates the clinic workflow for every guest.

A regulatory rule, coordinated by us

The screening is set by BBKSDA (the East Java conservation authority) under Surat Edaran SE.1658/KSA.9/2024 — it is not JVTO-imposed. JVTO integrates the workflow so every guest arrives at the crater gate with a valid certificate.

No valid QR code = no crater-zone access.

The four-step protocol

  1. A nurse visits your hotel the evening before the hike (Bondowoso / Banyuwangi area).
  2. Vitals recorded: SpO2, blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory history.
  3. QR surat sehat issued, signed by Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu, SIP (STR QN00001073380217).
  4. BBKSDA scans the QR code at the crater gate before entry.

**Website-only booking.** JVTO accepts bookings exclusively through the official website checkout under a valid JVTO Booking ID. WhatsApp/email are support channels only — they never create, confirm, modify, cancel, or transfer a booking.

**Canonical logic lives in the YAML** (compiler reads it directly). Full voluntary ≥48h → Lifetime Package Credit (no cash); full <48h → forfeited. **Partial passenger cancellation** (booking continues): ≥48h → 100% cash refund of cancelled pax price, <48h → 50%, after Day 1 → 0%. Package Credit: no expiry, no cash value, same package/pax/price locked, one transfer, no split. Flight disruption → 50% Recovery Fee (once).

value.package_guarantee_summary: Your confirmed package does not disappear when plans change early. Cancel your entire booking at least 48 hours before Day 1 and the same package, your original number of travellers, and your original confirmed package price remain available for future use as Lifetime Package Credit.
value.before_48_full_cancellation: Cancel the complete booking 48 hours or more before Day 1: you receive Lifetime Package Credit. It never expires and preserves the same package, original pax entitlement, and original confirmed price, and can be transferred once. Package Credit is not cash and cannot be exchanged for cash.
value.after_48_full_cancellation: Cancel the complete booking less than 48 hours before Day 1: the booking is forfeited and no Package Credit is created.
value.partial_cancellation: If one or more travellers cancel but the tour continues, the cancelled travellers receive a cash refund of their confirmed price: 100% at 48 hours or more before Day 1, 50% within 48 hours, and 0% after Day 1. At least 2 paying travellers must remain, otherwise it is treated as a full cancellation.
value.flight_disruption: If a verified natural transport disruption (for example volcanic ash) cancels your flight, your package can be reactivated once for a 50% Recovery Fee of the original confirmed package price.
value.destination_force_majeure: If a verified official event affects your destination and the whole tour is impossible, you can choose Lifetime Package Credit or a cash refund less any non-recoverable vendor cost. If only part is affected, JVTO first offers an alternative route, then a refund of the affected component.
value.package_transfer: Package Credit may be transferred once to another person. The old credit code is closed and a new one is issued to the recipient. A second transfer is not permitted.
value.package_redemption: To use Package Credit, choose a new date for the same package. Your original pax entitlement appears automatically; fewer travellers yields no refund, and more travellers are charged the incremental website price.
